description: This file defines the ClientObserversPlacementDirector class, which implements the IPlacementDirector interface to prevent placement of client observer activations in the Orleans runtime. It contains a method that throws an exception if activation is attempted.

classes.name: ClientObserversPlacementDirector
classes.description: A class that prevents placement of client observer activations by throwing an exception when such an activation is attempted.

methods.name: OnAddActivation
methods.description: Handles the attempt to add a new activation; throws an exception indicating the client is not available.
